content.content: Creating green spaces that bring beauty and substance into your life. Contact Us + Professionally Designed Gorgeously Grown Beautifully Maintained our Mission Our mission is simple, we want to create green spaces that can feed our body and mind while creating community. We hope that our garden spaces encourage our neighbors to come together and share in the dialogue of food and in the harvest of course! By being mindful of the environment and native habitats, we can create gardens that enrich our lives while promoting local fauna. We push back against water hungry lawns and strive to create spaces that bring beauty and substance to your home through organic and sustainable practices. We specialize in native, drought tolerant, and edible gardens in Los Angeles, and offer installation and maintenance services. To get a personalized quote, contact us. content.title: Edible Gardens
content.content: design + Installation + MAINTENANCE Edible Gardens Edible gardens don't have to look like a farm! No matter how much or little space you have, you can have a beautiful garden where organic produce, herbs and flowers are at your fingertips... all year round :) Services provided Design Installation Maintenance Natives Edibles How it Works Garden Visit Schedule a quick garden visit where we can discuss your garden goals and dreams. Custom Plan We will develop a custom design and plan to fit your home and budget. Garden Install Once you are ready, lets get planting! Edible Garden Ann's Garden This completely edible garden offers both sustenance and aesthetic delight in every corner. Vibrant herbs and edible flowers carpet the ground, while artichokes and lemongrass add intriguing textures. Nutrient-rich organic vegetables thrive in raised beds, and a sprawling 50-foot passion fruit vine now adorns a wall once covered in ivy. edible Garden John's Garden In this captivating formal garden, design seamlessly blends with function, directing attention to the raised beds and vibrant vegetation as the central features. This is where beauty not only delights the eye but serves a purpose. Edible garden Kate's Garden Kate's beautiful garden thrives on high density planting and efficiency. This summer garden grows a variety of leafy greens, squash, tomatoes, herbs and even edible flowers! Edible Garden Sanam's Garden This garden exudes the atmosphere of an urban orchard imbued with a tranquil homestead charm. Dotted with vibrant pollinators, this enchanting space yields a bounty of citrus fruits, figs, pomegranates, berries, and even chestnuts. And let's not overlook the raised beds brimming with lush greens and traditional herbs. Balcony Hydroponic Garden Nicole's Garden Nicole's smile says it all. Hydroponic towers maximize urban space, enabling year-round production of fresh, nutritious food with minimal water usage. Accessible and efficient, they empower individuals to cultivate their own sustainable food sources, promoting self-sufficiency and resilience. Nicole loves coming out to her balcony to harvest greens, tomatoes, herbs, squash and the occasional broccoli head. Green Girl Farms Green Girl We are a proud partner of this urban oasis where innovation meets sustainability. As pioneers in the movement, Green Girl Farms is dedicated to nurturing not just crops, but communities, empowering those around the Port of Los Angeles to embrace a greener, more inclusive future. Feed and Be Fed Feed and Be Fed Feed and be Fed is a non-profit urban garden dedicated to restoring food justice in the community of San Pedro by growing and distributing organic whole foods. We are proud to be able to take part in supporting their mission. Alma Alma Backyard Farms ALMA exists to re-claim lives of formerly incarcerated people, re-purpose land into productive urban farms, and re-imagine community as a place for people & plants to thrive. We are happy to have been part of their mission and grow out their farm from 2019-2021. It's time for your garden to flourish. Contact Us +

content.title: Water Wise Gardens
content.content: design + Installation + MAINTENANCE Water Wise Gardens Drought tolerant landscapes that bring beauty and function to your home. Services provided Native Gardens Installation Maintenance Design How it Works Garden Visit Schedule a quick garden visit where we can discuss your garden goals and dreams. Custom Plan We will develop a custom design and plan to fit your home and budget. Garden Install Once you are ready, lets get planting! residential Roof Top Oasis This minimalist roof top garden incorporates smooth stucco planters with succulents and native grasses. The granite modern fireplace and outdoor kitchen give this space a sleek look. Once a hot roof, now a hot place to hang out. Residential Simple and Sleek This a great space for a meal with the family any time of the day. Drought tolerant plants, large concrete pavers and composite decking give this garden a modern feel. Residential A Cozy Garden We went from a thirsty lawn to a luscious drought tolerant garden. The decomposed granite walkway allows for a nice sitting area to enjoy a nice morning tea. residential Garden Hide Away These intimate spaces became a great hide away. Large thick hedges muffle sound and neutral colors keep the mind calm. A custom water feature helps set the mood as well. Commercial Office Colors Bringing an office space to life with textures, plant material and a pop of color. This is a modern space where people can take a break from the grind and get back in touch with themselves. It's time for your garden to flourish. Contact Us +
